# BCGov Crow - v0.21.2

## Release type

Patch release: aligns Crow's agent and skill authoring and review workflows
with its published governance principles.

## Summary

The Crow authoring workflow now reads the canonical governance file and
prepares its Need, Fit, Trust, and Support admission record for proposed
agents and skills. The review workflow checks those principles and admission
answers without duplicating the policy.

Security review and remediation now route shared reference guidance through
the security skill. Security review and solution architecture retain only
the provider tools needed by their evidence and publication workflows.

## Highlights

- Authors of new or materially changed Crow agents and skills are directed to
  the repository-root `GOVERNANCE.md`, with a public source fallback when the
  file is unavailable.
- The authoring and review paths check whether the proposal solves a
  repeatable need, fits Crow's existing capabilities, handles trust safely,
  and has maintainable sources and validation.
- Security finding standards, version/dependency audits, analysis passes,
  and remediation guidance are routed skill modules rather than inline
  agent reference catalogues.
- Removed unneeded people, portfolio, and provider metadata grants while
  preserving scoped documentation, inventory, Sonar, and publication tools.
- Added `crow-sonar-scan` to package and plugin discovery keywords.

## Changes

- Updated the Crow Agent & Skill Authoring Agent and skill to include the
  governance read and admission decision.
- Updated the Crow Agent & Skill Review Agent, skill, and rubric to assess
  applicable governance principles and admission records.
- Reused canonical crypto, diagnostics, and control-assurance guidance
  instead of conflicting one-off remediation prescriptions. Aggregate
  coverage goals are project-defined, not a universal 40% gate.
- Aligned package, plugin, collection, and README version references.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: passed (0 errors, 0 warnings)
- Package dry run: passed (328 files, including all four relocated modules;
  no archive created)
- Archive inspection: not run
- Additional checks: remediation-scope, dependency-graph, handoff, and
  release-note checks passed; specialist and rubber-duck reviews found no
  material concerns. Sonar completed with an OK quality gate; the generic
  scanner did not analyze the unchanged C# test-utility templates.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.21.2 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.21.2.zip --global --target copilot
```
